trades.name: LAAF of 7786-7787
trades.quote: Short a LAAF of 86-87 is the best and safest way to express a bearish bias. Bulls are in control of intermediate and higher timeframes so this can’t be rated too highly but it is the one setup which could ultimately resolve down through Tuesday’s weak structure if sellers wake up this week for some reason. If intermediate and higher timeframes weren’t fully favoring bulls this would be an A++ rating. As it is I can’t give it better than a B+ and only that high because it has potential (though low probability) to produce an outsized move. I would watch something like 7781 from above which could hold and negate this trade before even seeing 72-73 if bulls are strong.
